title: VH Auto Reroll
description: Automatically rerolls the Vault Hunters Black Market until your desired item appears, using Create mod filters to define target items.
body:
# Auto Reroll Mod for Vault Hunters

Are you tired of manually rolling through the Black Market hundreds upon hundreds of times, just to get the exact items you want? Do you feel like you are not using your infinite rerolls given by the Whispers of the Market prestige effectively, because you don't feel like rolling manually? 

Well you are in luck! This mod automates this process, by letting you define target items using Create Attribute Filters! You can even tell it to automatically buy the desired item for you, so you can spend 1 Million soul shards in mere minutes while comfortably getting your coffee or tea. And if you are searching for really rare items, like Unidentified Treasure Keys, you can even do other things in your world, while the mod rolls through the market in the background (does not work together with auto-buying).

## Features

- Single click-based auto-rerolling with GUI controls
- Use Create attribute/list filters to specify target items
- Optional: Search Omega slot only or all 3 slots
- Optional: Automatically buy target items
- Configurable max rerolls (prevents infinitely rolling for unobtainable target)
- Visual feedback with sounds and tooltips
- In-game config access via shift-click

Note: currently only Create Filters are accepted, so for simple items use "is of item ID ..." filter.

## Usage

Make sure you have the Whispers of the Market prestige unlocked (greed T3). Open the Black Market, hold (or drag from jei) a Create filter or simple item, then click the filter slot (top-left). Optionally click switches to toggle Omega slot target only and Auto-Buy mode. Click the auto-reroll button in the top right to start; shift-click this button for extended configuration options.

| Filter Type | Matches | Example |
|--------|---------|---------|
| Simple item | Item ID only | Pyretic Focus, any Inscription, any Booster Pack |
| Create Attribute Filter (+ Vault Filters) | Specific NBT | Any Omega Inscription, Specific Inscription, size 5 Catalyst, multiple items |

Stops when: match found, max rerolls reached, or click again to cancel.
